prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='ONLY_FT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA leads in trend correlation (0.3103) while ONLY_FT_catboost excels at seasonality (0.398). NaiveMovingAverage achieves lowest overall RMSE (291.34). Rankings are unstable (Kendall τ=-0.13) with high model disagreement (spread ratio=0.66) and concept drift detected (trend reverses between folds), suggesting robust median/trimmed-mean combination over weighted stacking.
